name: Tomato Soup for the Heart
source:
Deep within the halls of a prestigious school for the magically gifted, trouble is brewing. Our protagonist faces expulsion. Her only hope lies in the hands of an unfortunately named classmate.

Can they defeat the odds?

[From [url=http://synokoria.tumblr.com/]Synokoria[/url]]
